title: aws_core error outcomes
description: Reviewed rows that name an AWS error as a result other than a failure of the call (req-aws-collector-outcome). Each row says which outcome a matching error is, and why that is true.

outcome.description: not_configured: the feature is not set up in this account. unsupported_in_partition: the partition does not offer the service or operation.

service.description: The manifest entry's `service`. A row always names its service; there is no wildcard.

operations.description: API-cased operations (ClientError.operation_name) the row applies to.

entity_types.description: Manifest entity types the row applies to (for a custom_fn whose own operation is not the one named).

error_code.description: The AWS Error.Code the row matches.

exception.description: A botocore exception class name the row matches (a connection failure carries no error code).

message_contains.description: Case-insensitive text the error message must contain, for a generic code that means this only with this message.

partitions.description: The partitions the row was observed in and applies to (for example `aws-us-gov`). An observation in one partition says nothing about another, so an unsupported row must name where it was seen.
